title: Splitwatch event
description: One edition of the Summer or Winter Games: its dates in the host's calendar, a day-by-day calendar of sports and medal events, and where its medal table is. Every fact comes from a listed source. No marks, names or emblems of the organizers.

id.description: The file name without .json, such as summer-2028.

place.description: The host city or region, in English.

timezone.description: The host's IANA time zone, such as America/Los_Angeles.

start.description: The opening ceremony day (YYYY-MM-DD, host's calendar).

calendar.description: One entry per sport and day with competition; filled by scripts/event-calendar.mjs.

sport.description: A sport as in presets/ where there is one, else a slug with a name in en.json (sports).

medals.description: Medal events (finals) that day; 0 for other competition.

medalsPage.description: The English Wikipedia page ID of the medal table, once the page exists; null before.

checked.description: The day the facts were checked against this source.
